esp-image.note: Canonical synthetic ESP32-C3 application descriptor and four inert segment payloads.

esp-flash-image.note: Offline whole-flash region recovery; no device, decryption or boot execution.

android-ota-payload.note: Full REPLACE operation only; no delta application or signature authentication claim.

ines.note: Upstream synthetic test bytes, not a game ROM; no emulator or mapper execution.

godot-pck.note: Plain Godot PCK v1, MD5-protected member; not encrypted PCK.

unityfs.note: Synthetic LZ4 literal-compressed blocks and directory; not arbitrary Unity serialized object interpretation.

wxapkg.note: Plain package only; encrypted PC-client packages remain upstream-limited.
